about_the_game:
Overview:

Start your journey as a rookie potion maker—meet Iren and explore the world of Potion Maker Iren in this demo version!
This demo focuses on the tutorial section of the game, allowing players to experience the basic controls, potion crafting system, and the cozy atmosphere of the fantasy world before the full release.

※ Please note: This demo is available in Korean only.

The full version will support English UI and subtitles, so international players can look forward to the official release!

What’s Included in the Demo:

  • Basic Controls Tutorial: Learn how to move, interact, and collect materials.

  • Potion Crafting Experience: Try out the core gameplay by gathering ingredients and creating your first potions.

  • World Introduction: Meet your owl companion “Hootie” and get a first look at the peaceful village of Glory.

  • Story Prelude: Follow the mysterious disappearance of the Armis Flower and get a glimpse of the upcoming adventure.

Notes:

  • This demo includes only the tutorial area; story progression and free exploration are limited.

  • Save functionality is not available. Average playtime is approximately 10–20 minutes.

  • Some features and UI elements may change in the final release.

Recommended For:

  • Players who enjoy cozy, heartwarming games

  • Fans of potion crafting, light exploration, and story-rich experiences

  • Anyone curious to see if this game fits their tastes before launch

Since this is our first time developing a game, your feedback means a lot to us!

Whether it’s what you liked, what felt unclear, or what could be improved—we’d love to hear it all.

Your input will help shape the final game into a more delightful and polished experience.

Take your first steps into a magical world—join Iren in her charming new life and get a taste of what’s to come!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F or higher
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard supported

short_description: As Iren, a rookie potion maker, as he begins his first job! Track down the culprit behind the mysterious 'Armis' flower, explore, craft potions, and enjoy a charming fantasy life!
